name: battery-bank
description: Recreated directly from phase-2/battery-bank.png as the sole visual reference. Octagonal wraparound frames, recessed end inserts, stepped orange covers, sloped nine-segment gauge with seven lamps lit, roof hatches, capped beacon, mounting skids and clamp hinges.
brief: Only visual reference: /home/baraa/chaos box/projects/Personal Projects/Docs/models and assets images/phase-2/battery-bank.png. Match silhouette, proportions, broad bevels, side orange inserts, three front covers, sloped instrument panel, roof seams, beacon and feet. Retain charge_bar, charge_segment_1..9 and info_anchor. Token colors supply game material values, no other image influences the shape.

metrics.partVolumeScope: Visible static closed mesh pairs, except alternates on different LOD levels; excludes intra-mesh intersections, motion, open surfaces and usable passage space. Positive overlap may be intentional.
metrics.openSurfaceScope: Visible static open surfaces sampled at their vertices against visible static closed solids, except alternates on different LOD levels; excludes open-vs-open pairs, motion, and any solid thinner than the sampled surface's facet spacing. Penetration within the contact tolerance is treated as intended contact, and penetration beyond it may still be intentional, as a fitting socketed into a shell is.
